ideas.title: Investigating the Minneapolis Shooting
ideas.description: This story would investigate the circumstances surrounding the fatal shooting of a Minneapolis resident by federal agents, including the events leading up to the shooting and the subsequent investigation.
questions: What were the circumstances surrounding the shooting?
How has the investigation been handled?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to uncover wrongdoing and hold those in power accountable. It requires a thorough investigation and analysis of the facts to determine what really happened.
